title: Fix VS Code And Cursor Chat Persistence
description: Fix devcontainer chat persistence for VS Code chat providers by reconciling persisted workspaceStorage chat data across changing workspace hashes after rebuilds and reattaches.
summary: Added post-attach reconciliation for VS Code workspace chat storage so Copilot and ChatGPT transcript/resource folders are merged into active workspaceStorage hashes after attach. Updated devcontainer docs to define the persistence requirement and verified the attach script runs successfully.
